clips.title: The story
paras: At Camp Taurajo, Mangletooth faces execution in a Horde cage and bargains with those who visit him. He offers knowledge of his rivals and Agamaggan's ancient lore in return for their help.

Tauren hunters and orc sentries keep Mangletooth in a cage at Camp Taurajo. The captured Razormane quilboar awaits execution, but he still tries to sway his captors and visiting Horde adventurers. He urges them to strike at the enemies of his tribe, hoping to prove his worth or win his freedom.

Mangletooth knows the religious history of his people. During the ancient War of the Ancients, Agamaggan's spilled blood gave rise to the Barrens' massive thorns. Mangletooth gathers red crystalline Blood Shards from fallen Bristlebacks and channels the lingering divine power within them, granting ancient blessings to those who help him.
